responsibility: Declares the Rust lexer interface and its supporting input abstractions. This header defines the `RAIIFile` wrapper for lexer-owned file handles, the `Lexer` class API for peeking and consuming tokens, replacing or splitting the current token, and querying line maps and filenames, along with the private parsing entry points for Rust literal, identifier, escape, and codepoint handling and the buffered input/token source machinery that feeds the lexer from files or strings and produces `Token` objects.
same_name_distinction: Declares the lexer-side types and API shared with the rest of the module—especially `RAIIFile`, the `Lexer` class surface, and its nested input/token source machinery—while `rust-lex.cc` supplies the concrete lexing algorithms and runtime behavior behind those declarations.
